(define (d2-tokenizer-identity tokenizer)
  ;; Registry identity alone classifies a foreign tokenizer. Once admitted,

      (d2-fail 'invalid-argument 'token-dataset-open
               "expected a same-aggregate tokenizer"))
  (vector (t2-private-tokenizer-fingerprint tokenizer)
          (t2-private-tokenizer-vocab-size tokenizer)))
